candidate_to_candidate_equality: current exact policy including finite bits, signed zero, masks, state and artifacts
timing_boundary: complete invocation through all required artifact/completion publication
candidate_pass_rule: one complete primary run <=1800 s with executed numerical/artifact gates and resource limits; missing large references remain unverified, not waived
interference_rule: freeze quiet-host conditions; retain every contaminated/failed/censored trial and its predeclared disposition
performance_lease: exclusive across all agents and local workloads
evidence_claim: single final observation, not robust reliability or statistical speedup
broad_release_matrix: deferred unless separately requested; existing required merge checks preserved
large_run_permission: only final evidence owner after freeze
